verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a cross-platform tool with a public GitHub source repository, and community reports describe users running and compiling it on their own machines and servers, so the core product runs under the user's control. However, the pack does not explicitly document build, installation or licensing terms for self-hosting. missing for 10: first-party build/installation documentation, explicit open-source license evidence in the pack, documented self-hosted deployment guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: A complete, cross-platform solution to record, convert and stream audio and video.
Coding examples are available in the doc/examples directory.
At work they once avoided buying GPU cloud servers after noticing the installed ffmpeg was compiled without GPU acceleration.
User says they use FFmpeg and Whisper to record and transcribe live police scanner audio for their city
